agent.description: The agent that does the review (Settings → AI → Agents). It needs permission to save drafts: set Entries: author to Allow.

entry_type.description: The entry type to review. Only published entries changed in the last 7 days are included.

message.description: What to check for. The week's changed entries are added for you, along with a reminder to write each note itself and save it as a draft.
message.example: Review them for typos, broken promises in the summary, and anything that breaks the house style.

timezone.description: The time zone the schedule runs in, for example `America/New_York`.
